film-tpm: Protecting Queen Amidala from Naboo's invaders, Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan discover young Anakin on Tatooine, and Naboo is freed at the cost of Qui-Gon, slain by Darth Maul.
film-aotc: Guarding Padmé from assassins, Anakin falls for her while Obi-Wan uncovers a secret clone army, and a rescue on Geonosis ignites war with Dooku's Separatists.
film-tcwf: Anakin and his new Padawan, Ahsoka, rescue Jabba's kidnapped son to win the Hutts over to the Republic, foiling Dooku's scheme to frame the Jedi.
film-rots: Tempted by Palpatine's promise to save Padmé, Anakin becomes Darth Vader as the Jedi are wiped out, the Empire rises and Padmé dies delivering twins.
film-solo: Young Han flees Corellia, joins Chewbacca in a coaxium heist on Kessel, and loses his first love Qi'ra to Crimson Dawn but wins the Falcon from Lando.
film-r1: Jyn Erso, daughter of the Death Star's reluctant designer, joins Cassian Andor and a rebel team on a suicide mission to steal the station's plans from Scarif.
film-anh: Farm boy Luke Skywalker joins Obi-Wan Kenobi, Han Solo and Chewbacca to rescue Princess Leia from the Death Star, then helps destroy the battle station at Yavin.
film-esb: Driven from Hoth, Luke trains with Yoda while Han and Leia flee to Cloud City, where Vader freezes Han in carbonite and reveals he is Luke's father.
film-rotj: After freeing Han from Jabba, the rebels strike the second Death Star while Luke confronts Vader and the Emperor, bringing his father back to the light.
film-mag: Sent to fetch Jabba's son Rotta, Din Djarin learns the Hutt Twins want their nephew dead and shields him. When they strike back, Grogu must save his father.
film-tfa: Scavenger Rey and defector Finn help the Resistance protect a map to the vanished Luke Skywalker, destroying Starkiller Base after Kylo Ren kills his father, Han Solo.
film-tlj: The First Order hunts the fleeing Resistance while Rey seeks a disillusioned Luke and bonds with Kylo Ren, who kills Snoke, before Luke's last stand saves the survivors.
film-tros: Palpatine returns, and Rey, learning she is his granddaughter, confronts him on Exegol with a redeemed Ben Solo as the galaxy rallies to defeat his Sith fleet.
yja-1x01a: Kai, Lys and Nubs fly to their new temple on Tenoo with young pilot Nash, arriving in time to stop Taborr's pirates from looting a local shop.
yja-1x01b: Yoda sends the younglings for mystery seeds; they snatch them back from Taborr, but Kai loses his lightsaber saving Nubs and is rewarded with Yoda's childhood blade.
yja-s01a: Taking on a training droid meant for older students, Kai, Lys and Nubs pool their Force strength to pin it until Nash and RJ-83 switch it off.
yja-s02a: When a tooka kitten in Nash's care escapes its carrier, Lys chases it through the temple's courtyard, dining hall and sleeping quarters before returning it safely.
yja-s04a: A playful bird keeps Nubs from a Zeilla flower the temple needs, until Lys sees his lightsaber dazzles it and Nubs rides the bird to the bloom.
yja-s05a: Hauling a Jedi holocron home, Nash threads the Firehawk through asteroids and a space slug's jaws to shake Taborr, landing hard at the temple with the prize intact.
yja-s06a: Routed by Taborr's gang during a market raid, Kai, Lys and Nubs refuse to quit, chasing the pirates to their ship and Force-pulling the stolen cart back.
yja-1x02a: In a no-Force river race, Nash and her Jedi crew team up with cheating rival Raena to escape the mud, then ride a geyser past her to victory.
yja-s03a: When RJ-83 is swept downriver, Kai leaves Yoda's rock-lifting lesson and, trusting the Force, braces a log at the waterfall's lip so Nash can grab her droid.
yja-1x02b: A temple-archive tracker leads the younglings to a centuries-lost Jedi ship and its stranded droid pilot, who must face his fear of asteroids to reach Tenoo.
yja-1x03a: When Nubs falls ill, Kai and Lys fetch healing Yara leaves, learning to temper his haste and her wandering focus to outwit the gangul guarding the plant.
yja-1x03b: Chasing a junkyard thief, the younglings find Taborr's gang has built a towering droid from stolen scrap, and Kai talks the machine into a better purpose.
yja-1x04a: Guiding a wellagrin herd across Andraven, Lys triggers an avalanche with a flute, then uses flute calls to find lost Jam and snatch him from another slide.
yja-1x04b: Skipping chores after a failed drill, Kai reprograms the training droids to clean up, and they run amok through the temple until the friends corral them.
yja-1x05a: Disguised as pirates, Nash and the younglings slip into Yarrum Tower to recover a farmer's stolen jellyfruit harvest, then invite even Taborr's gang to share the festival feast.
yja-1x05b: On a wildlife-show safari, a toothy bird snatches the droid hosts; Lys stays calm, wins over the mother with shiny berries and names the new species.
yja-1x06a: Test-flying their new starfighters, Kai strays into an asteroid ring and wakes a space slug that swallows his friends, forcing him to bait the beast into opening wide.
yja-1x06b: On Federian, the younglings and a band of skriffles make a stand for the last great tree against Raxlo's logging machine, tearing off its saws with the Force.
yja-1x07a: Stranded in a beast's lair with Master Zia and Ace Kallisto, the thief who took their shuttle, Kai must trust her, and learns wrongdoers can change.
yja-1x07b: Gruff bounty hunter Ansen Strung is reduced to hunting a runaway pet kibbin, and only catches the skittish creature once he lets the younglings help.
yja-1x08a: A gargantua bound for a nature preserve escapes at a fuel stop, and the younglings race to find the gentle beast before frightened townsfolk corner it.
yja-1x08b: On concert night, Nash's favorite band splits over who gets to sing; Lys and Nash save both bandmates from a waterfall and help them hear each other out.
yja-1x09a: Flying Princess Inaya and a gift for her father, Nash brushes off the royal's engineering know-how, until Inaya's skills ground Taborr's ship and recover the stolen present.
yja-1x09b: Overslept and left behind, Kai joins Nash on a Tatooine delivery that loses its cargo and RJ-83 to Jawas, and learns to seek the bright side.
yja-1x10a: When collector Draiven Bosh steals the town's Visitor's Day sculpture, Lys stows aboard his ship and learns that calling Master Zia for help is no failure.
yja-1x10b: A seed Nubs carries from botany class grows into a rampaging vine that invades the temple, until he studies the plant and smothers its heart in shade.
yja-1x11a: Tracing Nash's stolen speeder to a gang-ruled town, the younglings help Ori, the boy forced to steal it, rally his neighbors to oust the Ganguls.
yja-1x11b: While Hap attempts a friend's favorite stew, eggs in his supply crate hatch into hungry tikotiko critters that wreck the café, until he feeds them.
yja-1x12a: Stranded on a runaway train car, Kai and Taborr must work together to deliver a village's lumber, and Taborr surprises everyone by abandoning his heist.
yja-1x12b: The younglings and an explorer droid chase thieves who stole an ancient Story Stone, then help one of them, a Tharnakan, return it to his people.
yja-1x13a: Tracing tremors under Nubs's favorite tree, the friends find Raxlo drilling for sap and persuade him to abandon his haul to restore the balance.
yja-1x13b: Worried for her missing brother Ansen, trainee bounty hunter Senna enlists the younglings to find him, and the reunited siblings team up to wrangle a farmer's runaway burowga.
yja-1x14a: When Kai's overeager throw sends Ember the charhound racing into the woods, he and visiting Padawan Bell Zettifar follow her scorched trail and lure off a gangul.
yja-1x14b: On safari, Lys bonds with a lost baby creature, Diggles, and must give him up when the fearsome beast pursuing them turns out to be his mother.
yja-1x15a: When Nihil pirates raid Zepher's workshop, Nash leaves her getaway post against Yoda's orders and must steady her nerves to chase down the stolen Vectors.
yja-1x15b: The Ganguls hijack Taborr's ship with him aboard, so EB-3 and Pord beg the younglings for help, and a stubborn Taborr learns to appreciate his crew.
yja-1x16a: Miners on Ootoo Prime shun a cave said to hide a shadow monster, until the younglings expose Taborr's scare-and-steal scheme and help the miners conquer their fear.
yja-1x16b: Paired on a mission with Resmia, who bested him in sparring, Kai lets rivalry cost them a precious beacon stone, and only teamwork gets it back.
yja-1x17a: Bound for Starlight Beacon, the younglings answer a distress call, mistake reformed pirates for looters, then risk missing their tour to free the crew's mired ship.
yja-1x17b: Camping out to unmask a creature haunting Marlaa's junkyard, the younglings push past their fears and find an abandoned droid scavenging parts to fix itself.
yja-1x18a: Ignoring their sky-skimming teacher's advice to ride the wind, the younglings get blown far off course on Kondoraan and must learn patience to glide home.
yja-1x18b: Helping Omakan farmers with a harvest feast, the younglings find Grandpa Roog feuding with his son over farm droids that soon run amok, and reunite the family.
yja-1x19a: During Life Day on Kashyyyk, Lys drops a young Wookiee's glowing orb and races to recover it before the lighting ceremony, learning what the orbs truly mean.
yja-1x19b: Raxlo's mining melts the snow sheltering Andraven's wellagrin eggs on hatching day; the younglings outwit his droids, save the clutch and find him another dig site.
yja-1x20a: After a groundquake on Vuundalla, sheltered Prince Cyrus sees his people's suffering for the first time and, with Kai's help, defies his indifferent parents to deliver supplies.
yja-1x20b: Lost firehawk chicks overrun Nash's garage just before a big business visit, so she disguises her ship as a parent bird to lead them away.
yja-1x21a: Paired for a wilderness exercise, best friends Kai and Nubs bicker over directions and split up, until ganguls corner Kai and Nubs charges to the rescue.
yja-1x21b: Feeling left out on a farm convoy, Nubs is carried off with the stolen well drill, and Gangul boss Orryak plays on his hurt to recruit him.
yja-1x22a: Visiting Batuu, the younglings help Padawan Celesta Kami stop developer Ozon Nimbee's droids from felling Black Spire Outpost's rock spires, winning over her new neighbors.
yja-1x22b: When the grown-up Comet Runners steal the Jedi artifacts Taborr just stole, Kai and his friends team up with Taborr's gang to take them back.
yja-1x23a: Frustrated that he can't master a move on Batuu, Kai enters a Force cave whose visions of friends, Taborr and Yoda teach him a Jedi needn't be perfect.
yja-1x23b: Scrapping on Bracca with Eren Kitt, the younglings race rival Pikpik scavengers for power cells to save her failing droid, and she learns trading beats grabbing.
yja-1x24a: When thief Draiven Bosh steals Uncle Luggs's prized speedster from a starship expo, Nash and the younglings trail it to an asteroid hideout and fly it out.
yja-1x24b: Covering deliveries for swamped Nash, Kai mixes up every order and crashes the Firehawk before admitting he needs his friends to set things right.
yja-1x25: Taborr, secretly Prince Cyrus, tours Starlight Beacon with the unsuspecting younglings while plotting to steal its dedication plaque, until Kai corners the pirate and saves the ceremony.
yja-2x01a: Hotshot new Padawan Wes Vinik leads the younglings against the Ganguls, who are stealing a village's starships with their new cruiser, and must learn to accept help.
yja-s01b: The Ganguls' giant cruiser swoops to seize a friend's ship, so Nash lures the pirates off and ducks the Firehawk into a cave too tight for them.
yja-s02b: Overconfident Kai keeps botching new Padawan Wes Vinik's sky-ring flying course, until Wes admits his own mistakes and flies it alongside him.
yja-s03b: Sent to fetch a thruster part from the junkyard, RJ-83 and Wes's droid R0-M1 squabble it onto a scrap train, then team up to chase it down.
yja-s04b: Guiding three new younglings through the Tenoo forest, Lys must keep her focus when a curious fellwing carries one of them off to its treetop nest.
yja-s05b: Finding Taborr hauling parts out of Marlaa's junkyard, Kai assumes the worst and duels him, only to learn the pirate paid for them honestly.
yja-s06b: Too eager to impress a visiting Yoda, Nubs stumbles through the temple obstacle course, until the old master helps him find calm through the Force.
yja-2x01b: Kai chases homesick youngling Bren to Yarrum Tower, where a smooth-talking pirate, Clave Rollek, tempts the boy with a life of stealing and tries to take their ship.
yja-2x02a: Kai and Bell Zettifar help a blustering mayor recover his town's stolen nerf herd, then discover the rustlers are owed the animals by an old broken promise.
yja-2x02b: Lys and novice rider Myra track an uncatalogued creature for Aree, tumbling into a flooding sinkhole where they win over the shy leepur.
yja-2x03a: Stung by the Ganguls' mockery, Taborr captures a wild gangul to impress other pirates, and the younglings must coax him into letting the exhausted beast go home.
yja-2x03b: Nash helps Princess Inaya fix her secretly built starship in time for a royal ceremony, where Inaya learns her parents always knew about her mechanic's hobby.
yja-2x04a: Distracted by the ancient Pooba Jedi's lightsaber he found, Nubs lets a comet cripple the Firehawk on the way to Coruscant, and Yoda helps him refocus.
yja-2x04b: Captured by the Ganguls after picking a fight at Yarrum Tower, Wes Vinik is rescued by the younglings and Chigg, the reformed pirate he refused to trust.
yja-2x05a: Hoping to be hailed a hero, Nash leads her friends aboard a derelict pirate cruiser to recover the staff of Tenoo's founder, and wakes its vengeful droid captain.
yja-2x05b: When the Comet Runners raid his village and seize the visiting younglings, Prince Cyrus secretly dons his Taborr armor to rescue them, keeping his double life hidden.
yja-2x06a: The Ganguls kidnap Hap's musician friends to trade to the Hutt Bulcha, and when the younglings' rescue goes wrong, the nervous café owner finds his own courage.
yja-2x06b: When a rare barelia flower is dug up the night it should bloom, gardening youngling Linh wins over the reclusive collector who took it and coaxes her outdoors.
yja-2x07a: At an Ootoo mining celebration, Prince Cyrus's greed for a glittering crystal stirs up gem-eating amberflies, and he must put others first to help drive them off.
yja-2x07b: Crewing Gumar's sled in an Andraven rite-of-passage race, the younglings help him gather three trial items, and he tames a legendary zaba wolf with a reed flute.
yja-2x08a: Chasing the kroop birds that raided Fiorna's wild gomgourds before a harvest feast, Nubs befriends them by sharing fruit, and Fiorna learns she took their food.
yja-2x08b: When web-spinning spiders escape Aree's freighter into the temple, a frightened Kai must lure their king back to its pen, learning Jedi aren't ruled by fear.
yja-2x09a: The Ganguls scheme to spoil the Wookiees' Life Day, snatching their feast and targeting a sacred tree, until Orryak's nephew Daynaal defies her to help the younglings.
yja-2x09b: Kaliah Kublop's old journal leads Kai and Resmia to her hidden treehouse base, where they must defend its relics from Captain Blackbolt as Resmia admits a secret fear.
yja-2x10a: Short on credits, Ansen Strung captures a rare blue aklyrr with the younglings' help, then sets it free when his client, Draiven Bosh, double-crosses him.
yja-2x10b: Bolter, a Batuu girl, steals Lys's lightsaber to feel brave against a bully, and Lys and Padawan Celesta help her discover that courage doesn't come from a weapon.
yja-2x11a: When the Ganguls seize Yarrum Tower, the younglings and ex-pirate Chigg must team up with a grudging Taborr to slip out before the gang claims every ship.
yja-2x11b: Chasing a runaway jetpack through the Tenoo forest with Marlaa and her old adventuring partner Maz Kanata, Kai discovers his junkyard friend has a daring past.
yja-2x12: Kai learns Prince Cyrus is Taborr as the Ganguls loot the royal vault, and though the two fight side by side, Cyrus still chooses the pirate's mask.
yja-2x13a: Running Wes's volatile coaxium delivery, Kai tries too hard to copy his hero, until a Comet Runners ambush teaches him to trust his own style.
yja-2x13b: When the Ganguls steal Raxlo's new harvester on Andraven, the once-greedy businessman rallies the younglings, local kids and wellagrins in a snowball counterattack to take it back.
yja-2x14a: A fallen tree traps Nubs and two villagers in a cave, and Kai and Lys coax reluctant Raxlo into a rescue that costs him his harvester.
yja-2x14b: When her water-scout droid vanishes in a sandstorm, Braygh blames the nomadic Dostans, until Wes brokers a truce and they help pull it from a cave beast's tentacles.
yja-2x15a: When a rival sabotages her racing hero's droids, Nash becomes Wiston Freng's mid-race engineer, with the younglings in the pit, then steers his monopod to victory.
yja-2x15b: Minding an empty temple, Kai shelters thief Ace Kallisto and her droid from Bulcha the Hutt, then must defend his home when the gangster lays siege.
yja-2x16a: Led through thick fog by Draiven Bosh's worried droid, the younglings catch him trying to snatch a firehawk chick, yet Lys still saves him from a deadly fall.
yja-2x16b: R0-M1 breaks the Firehawk's accelerator, a chop-shop thief pockets it, and the go-it-alone droid must learn teamwork as Nash and Nubs help win it back.
yja-2x17a: Nubs and Lys help Zeepohz, a grown-up Pooba, haul his crashed ship's cargo to market, and Nubs learns there's no rush to grow up.
yja-2x17b: Ansen Strung and his old partner Rhugo Tar bicker over methods while hunting a starship thief, until the younglings help the rival bounty hunters work as one.
yja-2x18a: Bored by the rain, Lys leads Kai and Nubs up the temple's great tree, where they wake the sloth that guards it and must make amends.
yja-2x18b: Kai catches Taborr robbing a starship factory, but the pirate plays on their old friendship to escape, and Wes assures Kai still hoping for Cyrus is right.
yja-2x19a: Helping Eren Kitt search Bracca's dianoga-infested Badlands, the younglings find her Pikpik friends captured by Nihil pirates hungry for a navicomputer, and plan a careful rescue.
yja-2x19b: After Zotti leaves the stables unlocked, bandits make off with the runaway dunnels, and Lys leads him on a chase onto a moving train to reclaim them.
yja-2x20a: Rushing to help without listening, the younglings load a droid's crate onto a ship bound for Yarrum Tower, and must sneak in to retrieve it from the Ganguls.
yja-2x20b: Swapped missions leave Kai and Nubs herding banthas and Lys hunting an explorer's journal, each borrowing the other's strengths before Master Zia admits the mix-up was deliberate.
yja-2x21a: Answering Yoda's distress call from a volcanic world, the younglings brave quakes, beetles and lava to reach him, and learn that even Yoda sometimes needs rescuing.
yja-2x21b: At an excavation of ancient raka fossils, the younglings and their explorer droid friend stop developer Ozon Nimbee from bulldozing Tenoo's history for a resort.
yja-2x22a: The younglings protect a memory-scrambled little droid from bandits after his master's gem mines, but must stop bickering over the route to get him home.
yja-2x22b: When Tooba Jinx steals the rare squork Ace Kallisto is transporting, the younglings team the thief up with ex-bounty hunter Ansen Strung to chase down the slippery creature.
yja-2x23: When Orryak's pirate alliance seizes the Tenoo temple, Kai's plea for help rallies the friends the younglings have made, and even Taborr joins the fight.
yja-3x01a: Tracking a stolen droid part to the tinkerer Rek Minuu, the younglings help three mistreated astromechs break free of him and gain new droid companions of their own.
yja-3x01b: Distracted on Batuu, Kai loses Master Drow's package to a trash hauler, and the younglings and their new droids must save it from the dump's crusher.
yja-3x02a: Feeling he isn't good enough, the Ku-Bops' droid drummer slips off with droidsmith Rek Minuu for upgrades, and the younglings must rescue him before his big solo.
yja-3x02b: Chasing a meeka that stole her holocam, Padawan Celesta Kami lands the younglings in a ravine and learns that watching Tenoo's Night Lights beats recording them.
yja-3x03a: In a sunken starship beneath a Naboo lake, the younglings race Tooba Jinx for a Jedi star compass, then save the thief from a colo claw fish.
yja-3x03b: Testing new speeder bikes from Nash, the younglings help a lost lakeetah cub find his family, and headstrong Kai learns to listen to his droid Beepers.
yja-3x04a: Scouring Bracca for a vio-harp for her mom's birthday, Nash must learn to let the prize go, and her friends' three other finds become a family trio's instruments.
yja-3x04b: When a kloo-horn player entrances Bogachi's animals, Ember included, to build a captive audience, Bell distracts him with a musical duel while Kai frees them.
yja-3x05a: Captured by droid thief Rek Minuu, Cyrus begs the younglings for help, and though he abandons them mid-rescue, he returns to save them, winning back Kai's friendship.
yja-3x05b: When three bumbling Ugnaught thieves steal their shuttle's power converter, Nubs and Wes give chase, and Nubs learns to keep his cool atop their swerving speeder.
yja-3x06a: Tracking a stolen power cell, the younglings walk into droidsmith Rek Minuu's trap and face his mighty new droid Apexx, running it ragged until its power gives out.
yja-3x06b: After selling his old harvester to Bulcha the Hutt, who turns it on the wellagrins' home, timid Raxlo must find the nerve to stand up to the bully.
yja-3x07: Apexx hijacks the town's droids to drive the Jedi off Tenoo, so the younglings join his remorseful maker Rek to stop him, and years later reunite as Padawans.
aco-07: The Brendok night replays from the Jedi's side, revealing that Sol struck down the twins' mother and that the Jedi agreed to blame every death on Mae.
aco-03: Raised by Force witches on Brendok, young Osha longs to join visiting Jedi, a choice that ends in a fortress fire that tears the twins apart.
aco-01: Ex-Padawan Osha is arrested for killing Jedi Master Indara, until she convinces her old master Sol that the real assassin is her twin Mae, long believed dead.
aco-02: Sol's team races to Olega to protect Master Torbin, who instead drinks Mae's poison willingly, and though Sol corners Mae, she escapes toward her next Jedi target.
aco-04: Sol and Osha track Mae to Kelnacca's refuge on Khofar, where the Wookiee lies dead and a masked stranger with a red lightsaber turns on the Jedi.
aco-05: The masked Sith, revealed as Qimir, slaughters Sol's team in the Khofar jungle, while Mae overpowers Osha and takes her place at Sol's side.
aco-06: On a remote island, Qimir nurses Osha and tempts her toward the dark side, while Mae, posing as Osha, fools Sol only until he sees through her.
aco-08: Learning on Brendok that Sol killed her mother, Osha kills him and joins Qimir, while a memory-wiped Mae is taken in and Vernestra pins everything on Sol.
totj-02: Rescuing a senator's kidnapped son, Dooku and young Qui-Gon find the kidnappers are the senator's oppressed people, and Dooku's anger drives him to Force-choke the senator.
totu-04: Street kids Cad Bane and Niro are lured into a Duros gangster's casino heist, and when police catch Niro, young Bane rides off with his new criminal family.
totj-03: Probing Master Katri's death on Raxus Secundus, Dooku and Mace Windu expose a senator's lies, and Dooku's growing sympathy for the rebels deepens his doubts.
totu-05: Avenging his gangster mentor, Cad Bane kills the marshal responsible in his old neighborhood, and is arrested by childhood friend Niro after his own partner disarms him.
totj-01: A sabertooth snatches baby Ahsoka during her mother's hunt on Shili, but the toddler calms the beast and rides it home, revealing her gift in the Force.
totu-06: Freed from prison, Cad Bane returns to settle his score with Marshal Niro, winning the showdown only to discover the grieving boy Niro raised is his own son.
totj-04: Dooku blames his secret master, Darth Sidious, for Qui-Gon's death, and when Master Yaddle uncovers them, he kills her to prove his loyalty to the Sith.
fod-2x10: When a sando aqua monster besieges Theed's royal boathouse, Queen Amidala looks past the attack and finds poachers holding its baby captive inside.
tcw-2x16: With Bail Organa's troops on Christophsis starving for supplies, Anakin slips a prototype stealth ship through Admiral Trench's blockade and outwits the Separatist admiral.
tcw-1x16: On Christophsis, a string of Separatist ambushes points to a traitor, and Rex and Cody hunt down the clone selling out his brothers: Sergeant Slick.
tcw-3x01: On Kamino, the squabbling cadets of Domino Squad keep failing their final exercise, until Hevy, Echo, Fives, Cutup and Droidbait learn to fight as one.
totj-05: Deeming her drills too easy, Anakin makes Ahsoka face Rex's clones and their stun bolts, round after round, training she'll need when the clones turn on her.
tcw-3x03: While Jedi Ima-Gun Di makes a doomed last stand on Ryloth, Bail Organa and Jar Jar outfox a Separatist envoy to win King Katuunko's secret aid.
tcw-1x01: Yoda and three clones take on Ventress's droid army on Rugosa to prove to Toydaria's king that the Republic deserves his alliance.
tcw-1x02: The Separatist warship Malevolence wipes out Plo Koon's fleet with an ion cannon, and Anakin and Ahsoka defy orders to find the Jedi Master and his surviving clones.
tcw-1x03: Anakin leads Y-wing bombers through a treacherous nebula to ambush the Malevolence before it can destroy a Republic medical station, crippling its giant ion cannon.
tcw-1x04: When Padmé's ship is drawn aboard the crippled Malevolence, Obi-Wan and Anakin must rescue her and C-3PO from Grievous and send the warship crashing into a moon.
tcw-1x05: When commando droids overrun a remote listening outpost, Rex and Cody rally its surviving rookies to win it back and warn the fleet before Grievous attacks.
tcw-1x06: Anakin loses R2-D2, and the secrets in his memory, during a battle, then hunts for him with a bumbling replacement droid, R3-S6, who nearly gets him killed.
tcw-1x07: Anakin and Ahsoka infiltrate Grievous's secret listening post to rescue R2-D2 and destroy the station, as R2 exposes his replacement R3-S6 as a Separatist saboteur.
tcw-1x08: On Rodia, Padmé is betrayed to Nute Gunray by her desperate friend Senator Onaconda Farr, and Jar Jar, mistaken for a Jedi, bumbles his way into rescuing her.
tcw-1x09: Escorting captured Nute Gunray to trial, Ahsoka and Luminara Unduli are betrayed from within as Ventress boards their cruiser to free the viceroy.
tcw-1x10: Dooku lures Kit Fisto and his hotheaded ex-Padawan Nahdar Vebb into General Grievous's fortress, a test the cyborg passes by killing Nahdar.
tcw-1x11: Chasing Count Dooku to Vanqor, Obi-Wan and Anakin find that Hondo Ohnaka's pirates have already captured him, and agree to collect the Sith Lord for a ransom.
tcw-1x12: Double-crossed by Hondo's pirates, Obi-Wan and Anakin end up chained beside Dooku, and while Jar Jar's ransom convoy turns into their rescue, the Count escapes.
tcw-1x13: With Anakin gravely wounded after a crash on Maridun, Aayla Secura teaches Ahsoka to put the mission above attachment as they seek help among the peaceful Lurmen.
tcw-1x14: Separatists arrive on Maridun to test a deadly defoliator on the pacifist Lurmen, who must choose whether to take up arms as the Jedi defend their village.
